name: Comfort UI
author: Local UI Workshop
description:
Comfort UI 0.3.1 测试版：修复麦克风状态同步与扁椭圆名牌，增加开关过渡动画和五语言系统提示。统一主/快捷菜单、设置、详情、登录、键盘、HUD与相机。可选Google、MyMemory、免费Bing、AI或轻量本地模型；F8为持续气泡翻译开关。Bing无需Azure密钥，本地模型首次显式下载约511MB CPU所需文件，可选Vulkan加速再约32MB。小模型适合短句，支持CPU运行；失败保留原文，不自动跨服务发送。

140项托管、102项隔离UI检查和独立进程Bing/CPU/Vulkan合成短句通过，真实游戏PC/VR、其他电脑和长期运行仍需验证。Google既有公共429未解除。

Unofficial mod, not affiliated with, approved, verified or supported by ChilloutVR or Alpha Blend Interactive. Modifications may affect performance, security or stability.

Known issue: real-client HUD microphone icon may be missing while its status label remains; a following hotfix will address this.
requirements: Windows x64 and .NET Framework 4.8; local model download is optional. See repository installation and translation documentation.
changelog: 0.3.1：麦克风与名牌修复、状态动画、五语言系统提示、免费Bing与可下载的轻量CPU/Vulkan本地模型。真实PC/VR仍待验证。
